method: Crossref REST API. Screen A: query.bibliographic in {betting, sports, football, soccer, tennis, prediction markets, horse racing, gambling, bookmaker odds, basketball, cricket, baseball, golf, rugby, tournament, olympic} with filter issn:0169-2070 (IJF), rows=500; titles filtered by sport/betting keywords; authors matched to IJF board list by surname + first initial. Screen B: per board member query.author=<name as on IJF page> + query.bibliographic='sports betting football tennis prediction markets gambling horse racing', rows=40, same title/author filters. Name matching is by surname+initial only, so Screen B contains false positives (different people with same surname/initial).
